entities.name: Query LpxD
observations: 369 aa protein; exact sequence hash match to reviewed UniProt Q7VRD6 from Blochmanniella floridana.
Pfam LpxD domain spans residues 24–90; Hexapep domain spans residues 146–180.
Predicted molecular mass is 39,517.7 Da and theoretical pI is 8.92.
C-terminal hydrophobic segment is consistent with membrane association, but the catalytic assignment is based on exact sequence annotation.

entities.name: Q7VRD6
observations: Reviewed UniProt protein from Blochmanniella floridana with 100% identity and 100% coverage to the query sequence.

entities.name: LpxD lipid A acylation
observations: A tetradecanoyl-specific form is: UDP-3-O-[(3R)-3-hydroxytetradecanoyl]-alpha-D-glucosamine + (3R)-hydroxytetradecanoyl-[ACP] -> UDP-2-N,3-O-bis[(3R)-3-hydroxytetradecanoyl]-alpha-D-glucosamine + holo-[ACP] + H+.
Reaction is mapped to Rhea 53836 and Rhea 17817; enzyme classification is EC 2.3.1.191.

entities.name: Lipid A biosynthesis
observations: LpxD adds the second 3-hydroxyacyl chain to UDP-3-O-acylated glucosamine, generating the bis-acylated lipid A precursor.
